label: Worsening: great filters loom closer than ever
rationale: The dashboard is mostly red: the Doomsday Clock is at 89 seconds to midnight (closest ever), 72% of the world lives under autocracy as autocracies (91) outnumber democracies (88) for the first time in 20+ years, loneliness affects 1 in 6 people globally, and documented AI safety incidents rose 56%. Institutional trust is flat at 56% and US trust in government is near a historic low at 17%, while New START expires with no replacement. Countervailing signals (Bluesky, citizen assemblies, Australia's under-16 social media ban) show antibodies forming, but in the report's words the infection is spreading faster.
